meaning:
Ἐλιακείμ(Heb. אֶלְיָקִים),
Eliakim, an ancestor of Jesus: Mat.1:13, Luk.3:30.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.
the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,
